blocks.text: SCHEDULE: UAAP Season 89 basketball tournament – first round MANILA, Philippines–Mo Konateh showed just how dominant he could be for Far Eastern University in the UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament Konateh powered the Tamaraws past Ateneo, 93-70, on Saturday and nobody was more impressed by his performance than his coach Sean Chambers. “Mo was an unbelievable presence when I got here because our other imports before him were just okay.
